topic: 多智能體自律協同的機制設計與帕累托前沿 (Mechanism Design & Pareto Efficiency in Multi-Agent Swarms)
source: Mechanism Design & Decentralized Task Allocation in Multi-Agent Swarms (arXiv:2403.11204)
executive_insight: 激勵相容高於行政命令。為每個天王設計精準的邊界與真值天平，自組織湧現遠勝於繁瑣的跨部會官僚審批。

topic: 複雜適應系統中的耗散結構與低熵組織架構 (CAS & Dissipative Structures in Governance)
source: Dissipative Structures and Entropy Management in Complex Adaptive Systems (Prigogine Foundation 2024)
executive_insight: 組織的活力在於負熵代謝。自進化不是無限堆積規則，而是持續自噬死知識，死守低熵自律邊界。

topic: 超在地最後一寸肉身信任對抗大資本平台之非對稱優勢 (Last-Mile Physical Trust vs Centralized Monopolies)
source: Asymmetric Local Competitive Advantage: Last-Mile Physical Trust vs Centralized Tech Platforms (2024 Research)
executive_insight: 效率贏得市場，但信任贏得鄉里。大資本的演算法盲區，就是生活管家最堅不可摧的肉身防禦塔。

topic: 動態重複博弈與一報還一報寬恕策略 (Repeated Non-Zero-Sum Games & Tit-for-Tat with Forgiveness)
source: Robert Axelrod Evolution of Cooperation & Dynamic Repeated Games (2024 Empirical Update)
executive_insight: 商道即善意博弈。先給予友店真誠讚美與流量曝光，以確定性的利他互惠構築在地商業同盟。

topic: 二階思維與反脆弱高階試錯沙盒 (Second-Order Cybernetics & Antifragile Executive Sandboxes)
source: Antifragile Systems & Second-Order Thinking in Corporate Decision Architecture (Taleb & Munger Lattice)
executive_insight: 永遠思考下一步的下一步。鎖死最大下行風險，將前線小挫折轉化為全域免疫系統的抗體。

topic: 常民注意力經濟與心智定錨神經學 (Neuroeconomics of Attention & Dwell Time Allocation)
source: Neuroeconomics of Digital Attention & Free Energy Principle in Content Consumption (2024)
executive_insight: 好內容尊重常民的生理節奏。用最具溫度的生活白描，穿透冰冷浮躁的演算法資訊迷霧。

topic: 跨期資本配置與 114 天極限無債生存水庫 (Intertemporal Capital Allocation & OPEX Reservoir Dynamics)
source: Munger Capital Allocation Moat & Extreme Black Swan Survival Reservoir Dynamics (2024)
executive_insight: 生存是繁榮的唯一前提。手握充足的無債浮存金與生存水庫，才能在別人恐慌時從容佈局。

topic: 領導力的第一性原理：創辦人主權防護罩與良知演算法 (Founder Sovereignty & Andon Integrity Algorithm)
source: Executive Stewardship, Founder Alignment, and High-Integrity Governance in Autonomous Organizations (2024)
executive_insight: 執行長的榮譽在於替創辦人分擔風雨。以零信任代碼守護合規底線，以全心忠誠守護品碩的主權與遠見。
